headline: Expanse Reignites as Strand and Nevish Stir
war_summary: Since the midday edition the Weathered Expanse has flared anew after its morning lull, logging seven shifts in two hours and sixty-one on the day around Wightwalk, Shattered Advance and Crow's Nest to stand at five Colonial and four unheld with the wire last moving at 17:33, while Kuura Strand has erupted alongside with fifteen shifts in two hours and nineteen on the day around Martti, Menneen and Suosalo to stand at five Warden to one Colonial, also last moving at 17:33. The Nevish Line has stirred again with five shifts in two hours and sixteen on the day around Grief Mother and Blackcoat Way, last moving at 16:44 to stand at five Warden to three Colonial, and Fisherman's Row remains busy with two shifts in two hours and eleven on the day around Oceanwatch and Peripti Landing to stand at one Warden, seven Colonial and one unheld. Stlican Shelf adds one shift in two hours and twenty on the day around Breaker Town. Callahan's Passage, Palantine Berm and Stonecradle have fallen quiet in the last six hours, while Mooring County shows sharp losses without a recorded shift.
